arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
path='tmp/fuzz.py'
src=open(path).read()
src=src.replace('''    entries = random.sample(mnames, random.randint(1, len(mnames)))''',
'''    entries = random.sample(mnames, random.randint(1, len(mnames)))
    machine = None
    if random.random() < 0.5:
        states = ["S%d" % i for i in range(random.randint(1, 5))]
        transitions = []
        for i in range(random.randint(0, 8)):
            transitions.append({"from": random.choice(states),
                                "to": random.choice(states),
                                "command": random.choice(["a", "b", "c"]),
                                "cost": random.randint(1, 9),
                                "when": None})
        seen = set()
        unique = []
        for t in transitions:
            if (t["from"], t["command"]) in seen:
                continue
            seen.add((t["from"], t["command"]))
            unique.append(t)
        machine = {"states": states, "initial": states[0],
                   "state_param": "st", "message_param": "msg",
                   "transitions": unique}
        types.append({"name": "StE", "kind": "enum", "values": states})
        types.append({"name": "MsgS", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 2})
        for m in modules:
            m["params"] = [["st", "StE"], ["msg", "MsgS"]] + m["params"]
            m["result"] = ["r", "Bool"]''')
src=src.replace('''    return {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": calls, "pipes": pipes,
            "entries": entries, "machine": None, "runs": runs}''',
'''    return {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": calls, "pipes": pipes,
            "entries": entries, "machine": machine, "runs": runs}''')
open(path,'w').write(src)
PY
